fields.description: Montura 2 is a villa release at Grand Polo Club & Resort with three- and five-bedroom homes. The two bedroom categories have distinctly different layouts: three-bedroom villas occupy two floors, while the five-bedroom plans extend to a second floor. The launch fact sheet lists 206 homes.

overview: The official project page places Montura 2 within an equestrian landscape, with a community clubhouse and outdoor spaces for both sport and informal recreation. Its programme includes courts, a soccer pitch, a skatepark, gardens and a dog park. These amenities describe the wider planned setting; they should not be read as facilities already operating beside every villa.
research.locationNote: Montura 2 is in Grand Polo Club & Resort, which Property Finder places within Dubai Investment Park 2. The fact sheet identifies Al Maktoum International Airport and Downtown Dubai as access destinations. Check the actual route, entrance and journey at the time you expect to travel.
research.priceNote: Emaar's page states AED 5.5m. The Montura 2 launch sheet gives three-bedroom villas from AED 5.51m and five-bedroom villas from AED 9.86m. These are dated published references; live inventory and individual quotes require confirmation.
research.paymentNote: The original plan totals 80% before completion and 20% at completion. Two middle instalments are 15%, rather than 10%. Construction-linked dates are reproduced from the phase-two document; a later purchase needs an updated balance and schedule.
research.handoverNote: May 2029 is the estimated completion month shown on the Montura 2 payment sheet and Property Finder. It remains subject to contractual terms and current developer updates.

facts.label: Launch mix and average areas
facts.value: The launch sheet lists 195 three-bedroom and 11 five-bedroom villas. Their average BUA is respectively 2,981 and 5,303 sq ft, with average plots of 5,196 and 6,127 sq ft. Counts are launch figures, not available stock.

facts.label: Different floor arrangements
facts.value: Three-bedroom plans put all bedrooms upstairs, with a maid's room and living spaces below. Five-bedroom Type 1 adds a ground-floor guest bedroom, a fifth bedroom on the second floor and a lift shown across all three levels. Confirm lift supply and specification in the contract.

facts.label: Reading the area figures
facts.value: Plan totals include suite, carport and balcony/terrace components. They are not plot areas or entirely internal living space; minor rounding differences occur in component sums.
